dimensions.en: Image: 12 1/8 x 13 3/8 in. (30.8 x 34 cm); Overall with mounting: 14 in. x 37 ft. 5 1/8 in. (35.4 cm x 11.4 m)

intro.zh: 韩幹是唐代一流的画马名家，以画出马的神采而不只是外形著称。
intro.en: Han Gan was a leading horse painter of the Tang, known for capturing a horse's spirit as well as its likeness.

intro.zh: 这是归于他名下最著名的作品，画的是唐玄宗的一匹战马。
intro.en: This is the most famous work attributed to him: a portrait of a charger belonging to Emperor Xuanzong.

intro.zh: 它是“白画”：只用墨线和简单的晕染，不施颜色。
intro.en: It is a 'white painting', done in ink line with simple shading and no colour.

intro.zh: 马眼如火、鼻孔张开、四蹄腾跃，体现了中国人对西域“天马”的想象：传说它们汗出如血，其实是龙的化身。
intro.en: With its burning eye, flaring nostrils and dancing hoofs, the horse embodies Chinese myths of Central Asian 'celestial steeds' that sweated blood and were really dragons in disguise.

intro.zh: 后世藏家在画上和裱边加盖的印章和题字，记录了它一千多年来的流传。
intro.en: The seals and inscriptions later owners added to the painting and its mounting record more than a thousand years of its passing from hand to hand.

look_for.zh: 拴马的木桩：马被拴住，却在挣扎腾跃。
look_for.en: The post the horse is tied to, as it rears and strains.

look_for.zh: 马的眼睛和张开的鼻孔。
look_for.en: The horse's eye and flaring nostrils.

look_for.zh: 四周密布的红色收藏印。
look_for.en: The red collectors' seals crowding all around.

views.zh: 馆方称它或许是中国绘画中最伟大的马的肖像。
views.en: The museum calls it arguably the greatest portrait of a horse in Chinese painting.

quote.en: arguably the greatest equine portrait in Chinese painting

alt.zh: 一幅水墨画：一匹白马拴在黑色木桩上，扬头张口，四蹄腾跃，四周盖满了大小不一的红色印章和题字。
alt.en: An ink painting: a white horse tied to a black post rears with its head up and mouth open, surrounded by red seals and inscriptions of every size.

note.zh: 每一句都对照所注出处核对过；找不到可靠出处的说法已删去或改写。
note.en: Every sentence was checked against the sources it cites; claims without a reliable source were cut or rewritten.
